# att.JAPAN

> > att.JAPAN is a comprehensive Japanese tourism information media providing travel guides, cultural insights, and destination recommendations across Japan.

att.JAPAN covers destinations from Hokkaido to Kyushu, featuring detailed guides on hot springs (onsen), seasonal attractions, regional cuisine, and cultural experiences. The site offers both destination-specific pages and themed itineraries, with special focus on hidden gems and authentic Japanese experiences.

## Key Topics

- att.JAPAN
- onsen (hot springs)
- Tokyo destinations
- Hokkaido travel
- seasonal tourism (cherry blossoms, winter sports)
- Lake Biwa & Shiga
- Abashiri & Okhotsk Sea
- traditional Japanese cuisine
- shrine pilgrimages (Ise, Izumo)
- Nagano Prefecture
- regional specialties
- cultural heritage sites
- ski resorts
- seafood markets

## Major Destinations & City Guides

- [Abashiri - Drift Ice & Okhotsk Sea](https://att-japan.net/ja/491-2): Abashiri guide: drift ice, Okhotsk Sea & prison museum
- [Iwaki - Fukushima's Pacific Coast](https://att-japan.net/ja/450-2): Iwaki city guide: Fukushima's Pacific coast, onsen & aquarium
- [Hachinohe - Aomori Seafood Hub](https://att-japan.net/ja/483-2): Hachinohe city guide: Aomori seafood market & morning market
- [Glover Garden - Nagasaki Heritage](https://att-japan.net/ja/388-2): Glover Garden: Nagasaki World Heritage Western-style buildings
- [Shinjuku West Exit Area Guide](https://att-japan.net/ja/186-2): Shinjuku West Exit area guide: Tokyo Metropolitan Building & nightlife
- [COREDO Muromachi Terrace](https://att-japan.net/ja/139-2): COREDO Muromachi Terrace opening: Nihonbashi shopping complex

## Onsen (Hot Springs) Destinations

- [Tsuetate Onsen - Kumamoto Hot Springs](https://att-japan.net/ja/454-2): Tsuetate Onsen: Kumamoto hot spring town with koinobori festival
- [Iya Onsen - Tokushima Gorge Springs](https://att-japan.net/ja/449-2): Iya Onsen: Tokushima gorge hot springs with cable car access
- [Omachi Onsen - Alpine Route Gateway](https://att-japan.net/ja/omachi_onsen): Omachi Onsen: Nagano hot spring near Tateyama Kurobe Alpine Route
